title: MathCore: PlayStation Survivor
description: Tactical 2D mathematical survival sandbox engineered exclusively for PlayStation controller (✕, ◯, ▢, △). Match linear equations, track targets with the mathematical threat compass, and unleash chain lightning strikes.
controls: Left Stick / WASD: Move Mathematical Core Craft
R2 / Space: EMP Shockwave & Kinetic Plasma
L2 / F / Right Click: Place Geometric Parity Turret
